Name: Stardew Eda
Author: WillowArcticae
Description:
Replaces Linus, the wild man with Eda, the Owl lady from the animated show "The owl house".
 I replaced the sprites, portraits, some dialogue, as well as retextured Linus' tent to appear as The Owl house.
Requires Content patcher.

I made this mod for my sister, but I figured maybe someone else might find it fun as well.
